verdict.rationale: Modal is a serverless compute and infrastructure platform, not an agent or AI app that calls tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Modal itself connecting to MCP servers. The official skill for coding agents and the SDKs serve the opposite role: they help agents use Modal, not Modal use MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
